vndbSahAllocationPolicy: Current baseline-bound 4096-byte allocation units; exact complete file-size equality remains required across every observation.
control: A and C use the same immutable baseline package in independent fresh browser profiles.
timingPlan: Three warmups followed by twelve balanced ABC blocks. The second independent hosted job reverses each block. No retries or appended observations.
timingBoundary: Unchanged file-input change through post-UI import completion. No product or timing-harness overlay. Registration still validates all current numeric spans synchronously before publication; no work is deferred.
diagnostics: The native parser, encoder, compressor, manifest, and complete native package members must match baseline exactly. The native-only replay is not repeated because it bypasses the changed database registration code. Complete unit tests, adversarial registration tests, semantic browser receipts, exhaustive media and four separate process-memory observations remain required. Separate baseline and candidate browser traces follow timing and memory.
memoryPolicy: Existing complete-process-tree observer and fixed coverage rules, median PSS/private growth at most 5%, each individual pair at most 10%. Both independent host results remain separate.
statistics: Twelve within-block B/A, B/C and unchanged C/A comparisons per host. Descriptive paired percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 20261127. No control subtraction or pooling across hosts/corpora.
promotion: No automatic promotion. Review requires a repeatable complete-import benefit compared with both unchanged controls on both hosts, assessed against control variation, plus all correctness and memory gates. An inconclusive result is not a speed claim; all raw observations and failures remain available.
hypothesis: An origin-only plain-record brand and current internal-view/buffer brand checks allow a single complete ordered span validation before registration, avoiding per-row general object and duplicate-reservation dispatch for proven private numeric columns.
selection: The guarded synchronous validation candidate was selected after a complete registration-only Node CPU screen and a separate hardened-source confirmation. Those component observations do not establish whole-import benefit. The candidate remains independent of parser key proof, composite fusion, and CRC experiments.
